summary_1line: King Danda encounters the sage Shukra’s daughter Aruja in a hermitage, desires her, and ignores her warning to seek her father’s consent.

image_candidates.scene_text: In a forest hermitage during spring, King Danda approaches the radiant maiden Aruja walking alone among flowering trees.
Aruja stands calmly in the woodland clearing with folded hands, warning the desire-struck king of her father Shukra’s wrath.
